rules.reason: R-task supports the fresh uncached online-mode offline-detach no-live-signal boundary; R-entry/R-background support the separate lifetime and continuation obligations. The body permits no entry or an entry whose signal is already aborted for that boundary, and separately requires lawful cached refresh/later consumption, entered unconsumed completion, state restoration and old-result isolation.
